shortDescription: This all-in-one design is simplicity defined, with the ability to wash and dry large loads, effortlessly, in as fast as 89 minutes, the fastest among ventless washer/dryer combos in the market. With no need to transfer laundry, it quietly conserves your energy while using efficient heat pump technology that lessens energy use with every cycle. Understated, seamless exterior includes an intuitive 7" LCD panel that responds to your touch. Built-in intelligence provides the utmost fabric care.

features.text: Mega Capacity
This mega capacity washer/dryer combo is the largest front load all-in-one unit with heat pump technology so you can fit more clothes in every load and power through laundry day in less time.
How big is 5.8 cu. ft.? Big enough to fit a king-size comforter and more in a single load, for big time savings every week.
Sleek Ventless Design
Space-saving 2-in-1 configuration, ventless design and standard 120V plug means it can be installed virtually anywhere.
Flat front design, brushed black steel finish and tinted, tempered glass door brings a premium point of view to your laundry space.
Intuitive 7" LCD touchscreen simplifies laundry and perfectly complements the modern design.
Dual Inverter Heat Pump Technology
With LG SIGNATURE Dual Inverter Heat Pump technology, you’ll enjoy quiet operation and energy efficiency using up to 52% less energy.
The low temperatures are easier on clothes and can help them look their best for longer.
Advanced Washing & Drying
Built-in intelligence takes out the guesswork AI technology selects optimal wash/dry motions and settings.
Direct Drive motor provides even performance and precise tumbling motions that are extra kind to delicates no belts, no pulleys, no worries.
Fill the reservoirs once and ezDispense® automatic dispenser automatically dispenses the right amount of detergent and fabric softener at just the right time.
ezLintFilter + Auto Cleaning Condenser™
Convenient top location of the ezLintFilter allows you to easily remove lint after every load.
The Auto Cleaning Condenser™ powerfully flushes away lint and debris every time you dry for better airflow and enhanced efficiency automatically.
LG SideKick® Compatible
Add the mini pedestal washer and tackle two loads of laundry both large and small— all at the same time.
Discreet compact washer sits underneath the main machine and elevates the washer/dryer combo for easier loading and unloading.
LG ThinQ® Smart Features
Use the LG ThinQ® app to control your washer/dryer combo remotely or use voice commands with Alexa and Google voice assistants.
ThinQ UP™ enabled smart appliances may receive software updates for new, downloadable features and enhancements to be sent wirelessly to the appliance.
ThinQ Care™ helps keep your appliance running smoothly by sending proactive usage, maintenance and diagnostic alerts to your smartphone.
